sentences.text: Both the appeals have arisen out of the Land Acquisition proceedings in Multai in Land Acquisition Case No. 8-A/82/2007-08 award dated 10.05.2010.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Appellants have filed reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act for enhancement of compensation for acquiring the land for construction of Sondhia Irrigation Dam.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Land Acquisition Officer, as per the submissions, awarded compensation of Rs.6,83,670/-.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: On appeal Reference Court enhanced compensation to Rs. 10,20,515/-.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for Shri Imrat Singh that now this 2 FA-330-2014 appeal is for enhancement of compensation by Rs.1,50,000/- whereas the State has filed the appeal for reduction of compensation amount.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is submitted that whatever the award was passed by the Land Acquisition Officer that has been paid.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Now they have come for reduction of the amount awarded by the Reference Court.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for Shri Imrat Singh submitted that there was discrepancy in calculation regarding the number, length and width of fruit bearing and other trees.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Proper calculation has not been made.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Arguments on behalf of the State also focused on the same ground.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is submitted that revenue authorities in connivance with the claimants mentioned more trees in their counting, therefore, they got the survey done from the Forest Department.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: The Forest Department's report is Ex. P/4 which supports their averments, therefore, the amount should be reduced.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the claimant Imrat Singh submitted that the trial Court has considered these objections in paragraphs 22 and 23 of its award and has mentioned that only one year compensation for loss of income from selling fruits has been considered.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: He also submits that compensation was not paid within time, therefore, as per Section 28 of the Land Acquisiton Act rate of interest should be enhanced and this point has been covered in paragraph 39.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State did not dispute this legal position and submits that compensation was not paid within the stipulated time as mentioned in Section 28 of the Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Imrat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Arguments heard and case is reserved for orders.
